entry_item.definition: v t To keep vigil, hold night watch, safeguard, stand guard over; to make the rounds as guard during the night

example.definition: To guard a horse herd at night.
To cover up the fire for the night, cover coals with ashes to keep them glowing over night.
To watch one's crops against loss from thieves or animals.

entry_item.definition: faire sa ronde pendant la nuit, garder.
To keep watch. To watch at night. To stand sentry. To patrol. To guard.
